description: This job script submits a 16-node Slurm job to run DeepSpeed-based GPT-3 training on 8 A100 GPUs per node. It uses an Apptainer container with the DeepSpeed framework to execute a Python training script with Zero-3 optimization and gradient accumulation.

workload_class.step_description: Executes the GPT-3 training script using DeepSpeed inside an Apptainer container, with a DeepSpeed configuration, Zero-3 optimization, gradient accumulation across 8 steps, and a batch size of 4 per GPU.
